QuestInfo.name: Fenelle's Advice
QuestInfo.0: #p3000000# wants to talk to you about something. Talk to #p3000000# in the Community Hall.
QuestInfo.1: #p3000000# thinks you could be doing so much more as Kaiser. You have no idea what else to do, so as #p3000000# suggested, visit #p3000001# and ask for advice.
QuestInfo.2: #p3000001# knew right away what you need. Ask for some advice.

0.0: Sorry...#bAngelic Buster#k tends to get people off-topic. Anyways, you don't need to mess with all the trivial stuff in town. The #bprevious Kaiser#k was a role model for all the knights and was always willing to deal with the most dangerous matters. Maybe you should be aiming higher.
0.1: You do good work, but I think you can do much, much more. Go see #p3000001#. She might have some suggestions.

yes.0: #p3000001# is in Pantheon. Go on already!

no.0: #p3000001# always gives valuable advice. Pay her a visit.

1.0: Welcome, Kaiser. I have heard of your exploits in town. You are already coming into your own, and yet...you come seeking advice?\r\n#L0##bI guess so. #p3000000# said you might have some suggestions for me.#l\n#k
1.1: #p3000000# sent you? Hm...I know what he wants me to say. He wants me to tell you to lead the knights. However, Kaiser is never all-powerful when he first awakens. I have known three Kaisers, and each started as you have. It seems Kaiser and #p3000013# are both fast approaching their destinies...\r\n#L0##b#p3000013#? What's with her?#l\n#k
1.2: Oh. You must not have heard. #p3000013# left to seek her fortune.

yes.0: Kaiser seeks to fulfill the people's expectations, and #p3000013# seeks to prove herself in her own way. And yet...this is not the true path for either of you.
